import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {

	public static void main(String args[]){
		Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
		
		int w = sc.nextInt(), m = sc.nextInt();
		int[] a = new int[101];
		
		for(int i=0;i<=100;i++){
			a[i] = m%w;
			m/=w;
		}
		
		int carry = 0;
		boolean success = true;
		for(int i=0;i<=100;i++){
			a[i] += carry;
			carry = a[i]/w;
			a[i] %= w;
			
			if(a[i]==1 || a[i]==0){
				continue;
			}
			else if(a[i] == w-1){
				carry = 1;
			}
			else
			{
				success = false;
				break;
			}
			
		}
		
		System.out.print(success && carry!=1?"YES":"NO");
		
	}
}
